nodes.title: Fixed prompt · eight hard cuts
widgets_values:
This target phrase identifies only the camera's compositional center. It does not permit any person, object, pose, expression, gaze, wardrobe, prop, geometry, lighting, or scene state to change.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video creates eight static cinematic coverage views of <Subject 1> around the designated target, using the same source-defined scene and exact subject identities. The views are joined only by instantaneous editorial hard cuts.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], [Shot 6], [Shot 7], and [Shot 8]): fully_preserved - preserve the source scene's identities, wardrobe, pose, expression, gaze, hair, fabric folds, props, furniture, architecture, materials, colors, lighting direction, shadow placement, relative scale, and world-space layout. Infer only surfaces hidden from <Picture 1>, conservatively and consistently.

detailed_description:
A coherent cinematic scene-coverage study matching <Picture 1>'s visual medium, texture, color science, lighting, and production design. Treat <Subject 1> as one rigid frozen world. Every person is perfectly motionless: no breathing, blinking, gaze change, facial change, gesture, hair movement, cloth movement, or pose change. Every object, wall, floor, opening, furnishing, reflection, practical light, cast shadow, and contact shadow remains fixed in world space. The designated target remains the same exact entity and anchors composition in all eight shots.

These are eight discrete camera placements, not points along a visible camera path. At every stated timestamp, execute a true instantaneous scene cut. The first frame after each cut is already fully resolved, sharp, and stable at the new camera position. Never show the camera travelling between placements. No orbit, pan, tilt, truck, dolly, pedestal, crane, zoom, whip-pan, speed ramp, motion blur, optical flow, morph, dissolve, crossfade, transitional frame, or intermediate angle. Within each shot, the camera is locked off and static.

[Shot 1] Source-oriented establishing view of <Subject 1>, matching the source image's general camera side, camera height, framing logic, and lens character. The designated target is clearly readable and the scene is frozen.

[Shot 2] At 00:00.333, the shot cuts to a camera placed exactly 45 degrees clockwise around the designated target at eye level, using a 40 mm lens and a medium-wide three-quarter composition. The camera is immediately locked off.

[Shot 3] At 00:00.958, the shot cuts to a camera placed exactly 90 degrees clockwise around the designated target at eye level, using a 65 mm lens and a clean profile composition. The camera is immediately locked off.

[Shot 4] At 00:01.583, the shot cuts to a camera placed exactly 135 degrees clockwise around the designated target, slightly below eye level, using a 35 mm lens and a low three-quarter composition. The camera is immediately locked off.

[Shot 5] At 00:02.250, the shot cuts to a camera placed exactly 180 degrees clockwise around the designated target at eye level, using a 32 mm lens and a reverse wide composition that reveals the opposite side of the frozen scene. The camera is immediately locked off.

[Shot 6] At 00:02.917, the shot cuts to a camera placed exactly 225 degrees clockwise around the designated target, slightly above eye level, using a 50 mm lens and a high three-quarter composition. The camera is immediately locked off.

[Shot 7] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a camera placed exactly 270 degrees clockwise around the designated target at eye level, using an 85 mm lens and a compressed profile or detail composition. The camera is immediately locked off.

[Shot 8] At 00:04.167, the shot cuts to a camera placed exactly 315 degrees clockwise around the designated target at eye level, using a 50 mm lens and a balanced hero three-quarter composition. Hold this final camera completely static through the end.

overall_soundscape:
No dialogue, voices, room tone, Foley, ambience, or sound effects; complete silence.

non_diegetic_music:
None.

nodes.title: README · edit one field
widgets_values:
# H3 Cinematic Multishot Coverage — core only

1. Load one source scene in **Picture 1**.
2. Edit only the red **Coverage target · EDIT THIS** field. ```"the woman seated at the desk in <Picture 1>. Keep this exact woman as the compositional target in every shot."```
3. Queue at 124 frames. The workflow extracts eight stable frames and saves a 4×2 contact sheet plus the eight views.
4. The fixed prompt asks for instantaneous hard cuts, not an orbit.

The source image is a **semantic Ref2VA reference**. It guides identity, scene, style, and layout, but it is not VAE-locked as frame zero; invisible geometry must be inferred.

Inspired by **C_Nugget / PoopMan333**:
https://huggingface.co/PoopMan333/H3_Character_Sheet_Generator

Native H3 models:
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3
